items.title: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
items.description: Spain said most had returned to Morocco by Friday evening, as Italy suspended its Schengen agreement on free movement with Madrid.

items.title: Bowen: Plan for Hamas to disarm faces big obstacles, yet it offers rare hope for Gaza
items.description: The realities of politics, war, zero trust, the deaths of thousands and the destruction of Gaza will make any agreement very complicated.

items.title: Body of US climber the latest recovered after Pakistan avalanche
items.description: The bodies of two other climbers have already been recovered from the mountain, while others are still missing.

items.title: Peru's ex-president has 15-year jail sentence for corruption charges overturned
items.description: Ollanta Humala had been convicted of money laundering offences alongside his wife in 2025.

items.title: Hundreds escape Greek wildfire by sea as blazes continue across Europe
items.description: Around 500 people, mostly tourists, are evacuated by boat from Agios Vasileios after becoming trapped.

items.title: Fifa says 'nobody selling football' as plan continues
items.description: Football's governing body Fifa plans to continue the consultation process after Uefa threatens to boycott World Cups.

items.title: UK rapper Yung Filly found not guilty of raping woman after Australian show
items.description: The YouTuber has been found guilty for two counts of assault over the 2024 incident in Perth.

items.title: Spain sending troops as thousands enter enclave of Ceuta from Morocco
items.description: At least 18 people drown as migrants try to swim to Spanish territory amid scenes of chaos at the border.

items.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
items.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

items.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
items.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

items.title: Uefa to boycott World Cups if Fifa plans approved
items.description: Uefa says "the World Cup is not for sale" after its 55 member associations vote to boycott future tournaments if Fifa and its president, Gianni Infantino, do not back down on their investment proposals.

items.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
items.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

items.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
items.description: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

items.title: Father of teen school shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
items.description: "It is clear you failed as a parent," the judge told Colin Gray, who was found guilty earlier this year on charges stemming from the deadly 2024 school attack.

items.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
items.description: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.

items.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
items.description: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude AI escapes to hack into three organisations
items.description: It comes just days after rival OpenAI said rogue AI agents had breached other firms' networks.

items.title: Thousands evacuated in Crete as wildfires threaten tourist resorts
items.description: Strong winds have fanned the flames in the Rethymno region as wildfires continue to ravage the Greek island.

items.title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents
items.description: It marks a change of tone for his administration, which has taken a more hands-off approach to the technology.

items.title: Veteran Ugandan opposition leader collapses in court and in ICU, his wife says
items.description: The 70 year old has been in detention since November 2024 and faces treason charges, which he denies.
